_template: THE YOUNGSTER — Decision Record Template v1.0
_instructions: Every important decision gets its own record. Decisions are immutable history — never delete or rewrite.
title: [Brief title: WHAT was decided]
category: [technical | product | operational | strategic | financial | team | timeline | vendor]

context: [The situation that required a decision to be made]
